user.title: Uray Quad Decoder
user.description: Connect to a Uray UHCVD265-1-4K quad video decoder.

scenes.title: Scene Presets
scenes.description: Define scene presets. Each scene has a name, a layout (wnd: 1 = single full-screen, 4 = quad), and per-channel (ch0-ch3) stream definitions. Leave empty to skip voice scenes and use only the 4 channel selects.
